desc.singulo.accelerator_controller: Controls a square ring 8–32 wide. Bigger rings are faster and yield more monopoles.
desc.singulo.accelerator_focusing_magnet: Magnet for the ring corners and at least 1/4 of the ring.
desc.singulo.accelerator_tube: Tube segment of the Particle Accelerator ring.
desc.singulo.accretion_jet_forge: A facility that forges materials with a beam squeezed from the jets of a black hole.
desc.singulo.advanced_android_workbench: An upgraded Android Workbench. Androids craft eight times as fast as on a vanilla crafting table, and the holding box has 54 slots. Androids use 60% of the usual charge per craft. Used the same way as the Android Workbench.
desc.singulo.advanced_worldline_anchor: Advanced chunk loader. Embedding a Singularity Core makes it free and maximal.
desc.singulo.afterglow_wings: Wings of crystal feathers born from the Last Archivist's light. Wear them on your chest to glide; sneak while gliding to beat them and surge ahead. No fall damage.
desc.singulo.android_apron: An apron with a frilled hem. Goes in the waist slot of the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_armor_plate: One fitted to a guard android works as its chestplate (+8 armor, +2 toughness). Takes armor enchantments.
desc.singulo.android_armor_plate_2: An Android Armor Plate reinforced with nihonium. Fitted to a guard android, it works as a chestplate (+10 armor, +4 toughness, +0.1 knockback resistance). Keeps the enchantments of the plate it was made from.
desc.singulo.android_armor_plate_3: The top armor plate, reforged with collapsar. Fitted to a guard android, it works as a chestplate (+12 armor, +6 toughness, +0.25 knockback resistance). Does not burn. Keeps the enchantments of the plate it was made from.
desc.singulo.android_backpack_upgrade: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 12 inventory slots (2 rows of 6). The android wears it on its back. Used to make the Reinforced Backpack (18 slots) and the Large Backpack (24 slots).
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass: Glass that only androids cannot pass. Players and other creatures go straight through. Joins seamlessly with the same glass next to it.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass_patte: Patterned glass that only androids cannot pass.
Stairs made from Patterned Android Barrier Glass.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass_slab: A half-height Android Barrier Glass. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass_stair: Stairs made from Android Barrier Glass.
desc.singulo.android_battery_upgrade: Fitted to a guard android, each one raises its full charge by 50% (up to two). A battery pack appears on its waist for each.
desc.singulo.android_beret: A beret for an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_book: A book an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_bouquet: A bouquet an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_broom: A broom an android holds upright while idle. Goes in the hand slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the binding.
desc.singulo.android_cape: A cape hanging from an android's shoulders that flutters as it walks. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_capsule: A glass capsule holding a dormant white android body.
desc.singulo.android_cat_ears: A headband with cat ears for an android. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_cat_tail: A cat tail that sways behind the waist, with a lighter tip. Goes in the waist slot of the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_charger: While you carry it, a following android comes close and recharges as it walks with you (30 full charges when full). Right-click a block that supplies power to charge it.
desc.singulo.android_charger_2: An improved Android Wireless Charger. Holds 150 full android charges and charges androids that ran out of power twice as fast, from up to 8 blocks away. Right-click a block that outputs power to charge it.
desc.singulo.android_charger_3: The top wireless charger, housed in collapsar. Holds 800 full android charges and charges four times as fast from up to 16 blocks away. It also tops up your androids within 16 blocks once they drop below half, without interrupting their work or fights (the power comes out of the charger).
desc.singulo.android_delivery_port: Androids bring finished orders here (choose it as the destination when ordering). A 27-slot box you can name in its screen; it moves its contents into adjacent chests by itself.
desc.singulo.android_diamond_brooch: A bow brooch with a diamond knot, pinned on the front of the waist. Goes in the waist slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the bow; the diamond stays.
desc.singulo.android_diamond_earrings: Diamonds that sway below both ears. Goes in the face slot of the decoration page, like glasses. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the metal; the diamonds stay.
desc.singulo.android_diamond_necklace: A fine chain that dips into a V with a diamond pendant. Goes in the neck / back slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the chain and setting; the diamond stays.
desc.singulo.android_diamond_tiara: A small crown with three peaks set with diamonds. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the metal; the diamonds stay.
desc.singulo.android_dual_tank_upgrade: Only works when Mekanism is installed. In the tank slot it gives two liquid tanks and two chemical tanks (16,000 mB each; the same total as a Tank Upgrade), for work that uses both. Glass tubes and gas cylinders show at its waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_factory_print_unit: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station's print unit slot, printing takes half the time and power, and repairs on the station run twice as fast.
desc.singulo.android_fairy_wings: Four clear wings that flutter slowly on an android's back. Goes in the neck / back slot of the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_farming_upgrade: Lets a guard android do farming steps on procedure cards: tilling soil and planting seeds, or giving bone meal to growing crops.
desc.singulo.android_felling_upgrade: Lets a guard android do felling steps on procedure cards (cutting whole trees and replanting saplings), like a diamond axe. Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
desc.singulo.android_fishing_upgrade: Lets a guard android do fishing steps on procedure cards (fishing in the water of an area). Takes Luck of the Sea and Lure.
desc.singulo.android_gas_tank_upgrade: Only works when Mekanism is installed. In the tank slot it gives two tanks for Mekanism chemicals (gases, infuse types, pigments, slurries; 32,000 mB each, one chemical per tank), so work can carry chemicals from the stockpile to machines. Gas cylinders show at its waist. Click a tank in the screen with a chemical tank to fill or draw. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass: Glass that only androids can pass; solid for everything else. Joins seamlessly with the same glass next to it.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass_patterne: Patterned glass that only androids can pass.
Stairs made from Patterned Android Gate Glass.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass_slab: A half-height Android Gate Glass. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass_stairs: Stairs made from Android Gate Glass.
desc.singulo.android_glasses: Square glasses for an android, with clear light-blue lenses. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dye the frames with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_hair_flower: A flower hair ornament worn on the right side of an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_headdress: A frilled headdress for an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_kit: A set of parts and shell. An Android Assembly Station uses one each time it prints an android.
desc.singulo.android_lantern: A lantern an android carries while idle. Its flame looks bright even in the dark, though it does not light the area. Goes in the hand slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the metal frame.
desc.singulo.android_large_backpack_upgr: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 24 inventory slots (4 rows of 6), the largest backpack. You can swap it in for a smaller backpack without emptying it.
desc.singulo.android_memory_axe: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Axe Android prototyped in the underground android laboratory. Dropped by the laboratory overseer. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_bit: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Bit Android prototyped in the underground android laboratory. Dropped by the laboratory overseer. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_blade: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Blade Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_gunner: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Gunner Android. Light keeps flowing through its crystal. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_katana: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Katana Android. Now and then a crimson slash cuts through its crystal. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_saber: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Saber Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_spark: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Spark Android. Now and then forked lightning flickers through its crystal. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_whip: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Whip Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_mining_upgrade: Fitted to a guard android, it lets the android do mining work (like a diamond pickaxe). Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
desc.singulo.android_monocle: A monocle on a chain for the right eye. Goes in the face slot of the decoration page, like glasses. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the rim.
desc.singulo.android_necktie: A striped necktie from a knot at the collar down the chest. Goes in the neck / back slot of the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_ponytail: A high ponytail in the android's own hair color. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the hair tie.
desc.singulo.android_production_upgrade: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station, it prints and looks after up to two androids. Only one can charge on top at a time; the other waits beside it and takes its turn.
desc.singulo.android_recipe_rack: A six-row rack. Put a Work Location Card on the left of a row and up to eight recipe cards on the right, and they can be ordered as recipes made at that location.
desc.singulo.android_reinforced_backpack: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 18 inventory slots (3 rows of 6). You can swap it in for a smaller backpack without emptying it, since the contents still fit. Used to make the Large Backpack.
desc.singulo.android_repair_kit: Kept in a guard android's inventory, one is used to restore half its health when it gets hurt (when they run out, it returns to its station).
desc.singulo.android_ribbon: A ribbon tied at the back of an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_scarf: A scarf wrapped around an android's neck. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_station: Prints one guard android (two with a Production Upgrade) from a compact crystal memory, an android kit and power, and reprints it with a new kit if it falls. Set how it moves and at what health it comes back to repair and recharge.
desc.singulo.android_straw_hat: A straw hat with a ribbon. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the ribbon.
desc.singulo.android_supply_port: Connects the storage next to it (chests and the like) and fluid tanks as the work stockpile. Androids take materials here and put what they make back.
desc.singulo.android_tank_upgrade: Gives a guard android two tanks for liquids and gases (32,000 mB each, one fluid per tank), so work can carry fluids from the stockpile to machines. The tanks show at its waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_teacup: A teacup an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table. Right-click to place it as a cup on a saucer; it keeps its color and comes back when broken.
desc.singulo.android_transfer_upgrade: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station's upgrade slot, an android that falls or is dismantled sends its inventory (repair kits, armor plate, upgrades and carried items) to the station instead of dropping it, and the next android it prints carries it.
desc.singulo.android_twin_tails: Twin tails in the android's own hair color. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dyeing it on a crafting table changes the hair ties.
desc.singulo.android_umbrella: An umbrella an android holds up while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_waist_ribbon: A large bow tied at the back of an android's waist. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_weapon_module: Fitted to a guard android weapon module slot, raises the damage of all its moves by 30%. Takes sword enchantments (Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Fire Aspect, Knockback, Looting), which apply to all of its attacks.
desc.singulo.android_weapon_module_2: An improved Output Amplifier. Raises the damage of all moves by 60%. Keeps the enchantments of the amplifier it was made from.
desc.singulo.android_weapon_module_3: The top Output Amplifier, built around a collapsar core. Doubles the damage of all moves. Does not burn. Keeps the enchantments of the amplifier it was made from.
desc.singulo.android_witch_hat: A pointed hat with a bent tip. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_work_console: Brings together the supply ports, delivery ports and recipe racks linked to it with a Work Location Card, takes orders and hands the work to nearby androids. It works as a supply port and a delivery port itself, and its Record tab writes recipes onto recipe cards. Orders need every material in stock.
desc.singulo.android_workbench: Where androids make crafting-table recipes, four times as fast as a vanilla crafting table. Record it on the Work Location Card in a recipe rack. Crafted items that do not fit in the android's inventory go into its holding box until the android comes back (right-click to take what is left).
desc.singulo.annunciator_panel: A bank of labeled alarm windows for the plant systems.
desc.singulo.anomaly_emitter: A plate set into the floors of the Final Lab antechamber. It fills the space above it (5×7×5) with a field: lift raises you, heavy pulls you down faster and slows you, slow applies Slowness and Mining Fatigue, and fast grants Speed and Haste. Fields affect enemies too. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.archive_terminal: Copies ruin records onto data cards, restores degraded parts and decodes crystal memories.
desc.singulo.archivist_halo: The halo the Last Archivist wore. It is still quietly warm and faintly whispers in an old tongue.
desc.singulo.area_card: Sneak-use two blocks to record the area between them as corners (up to 128 blocks per side; one card is split off a stack). Sneak-use again to record anew; sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Used on the Routes page of the work console and assembly station for the area a waypoint covers and for no-entry zones.
desc.singulo.artificial_star_core: A star core that replaces nether stars.
desc.singulo.assembly_stock_upgrade: Install in the bottom-right slot of the Precision Assembler to stock multiple stacks of the same part in each cell. Unstackable tools occupy one cell each. Remove the upgrade once every cell holds 64 items or fewer.
desc.singulo.awakening_echo_core: A sentinel core overlaid with echo-shard records. Use it on the guardian core in a Research Building to call the Awakened Echo Sentinel: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, an extra echo, and it re-projects broken projectors when enraged. Victory adds an overclock chip and more to the usual drops.
desc.singulo.awakening_ergosphere_core: A Chapter of the Vortex spun up again with jet condensate and H-Condensate. Use it on the guardian core of a Sunken Reactor Sector to call the Awakened Ergosphere Leviathan: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster swimming, chained dives and a breath that tracks you.
desc.singulo.awakening_foundry_core: Precision actuators charged with singularity power to reawaken the overseer's command chain. Use it on the guardian core in an Android Laboratory to wake the Awakened Foundry: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, and it reprints its broken production lines once when enraged.
desc.singulo.awakening_gravity_core: A degenerate nucleus charged with singularity power. Use it on the guardian core in a Culture Facility to call the Awakened Gravity Remnant: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, more debris, a wider and stronger gravity well, and chained slams. Victory adds an overclock chip and more to the usual drops.
desc.singulo.awakening_record_core: A record of the defeated warden, reforged with singularity power. Use it on the Seal Console in the final lab to wake the Awakened Horizon Warden: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves. Victory yields overclock chips and more.
desc.singulo.basic_circuit: An electronic circuit for basic control.
desc.singulo.basic_frame: The frame almost every machine is built on.
desc.singulo.battery_fluid_capsule: A fluid capsule with a battery. Reaches 760 blocks.
desc.singulo.battery_packing_crate: A packing crate with an extra battery. Reaches up to 760 blocks.
desc.singulo.bismuth_crystal_block: Stepped, rainbow-tarnished crystals grown from molten bismuth. A building block.
desc.singulo.bismuth_ingot: A metal with an iridescent surface. A quiet touch of color from copper refining.
desc.singulo.black_hole_bomb: Thrown: opens a tiny black hole that swallows its surroundings.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass: See-through, as hard and blast-resistant as the Black Reinforced Panel. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass_slab: A half-height Black Reinforced Glass. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass_stai: Stairs made from Black Reinforced Glass.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_light_pane: A Black Reinforced Panel that glows brightly (light 15). As blast-resistant as obsidian; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel: A black panel as blast-resistant as obsidian. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel_slab: A half-height Black Reinforced Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel_stai: Stairs made from Black Reinforced Panel.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel_wall: A Black Reinforced Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.black_star_glass: Black Reinforced Glass with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.blank_data_card: An empty card for copying records in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.blueprint_lab_building: Plans for laboratory walls and floors.
desc.singulo.blueprint_lab_furniture: Plans for ancient furniture and fixtures.
desc.singulo.blueprint_rayleigh: Plans for an artificial blue-sky panel.
desc.singulo.broken_ruin_glass: A cracked ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.builder_wand: Creative only. Instantly builds the multiblock of a controller. Sneak to change size.
desc.singulo.bulkhead: A heavy door sealing the laboratory core section. It opens when facility power returns. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.canned_soda: A blue can of soda from the laboratory's vending machine. Drinking it gives Speed for 2 minutes.
desc.singulo.capacity_upgrade_1: Install one in a processing machine’s capacity slot for a minimum buffer of 1,000,000 FE. Works alongside speed upgrades; intake limits stay unchanged. Removing it preserves surplus charge and blocks reception until the buffer falls below capacity.
desc.singulo.capacity_upgrade_2: Made from Mk1. Raises a processing machine’s buffer to at least 4,000,000 FE. Install one in the dedicated capacity slot; intake limits stay unchanged.
desc.singulo.capacity_upgrade_3: Made from Mk2. Raises a processing machine’s buffer to at least 40,000,000 FE. Install one in the dedicated capacity slot; intake limits stay unchanged.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity: Creates negative energy between mirrors to make exotic matter.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_controller: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 cavity.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_frame: Frame along the cavity edges (not the corners).
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_mirror_plate: Inner 3×3 of the cavity top and bottom: two facing mirrors.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_pump: Vacuum pumps on the eight corners.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_shield: Magnetic shields either side of each window.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_wall: Vessel wall; any can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_window: Middle of each side; shows the vacuum between the mirrors.
desc.singulo.catalyst_stabilizer: Use with a catalyst in your other hand to double its remaining life. Once per catalyst.
desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor: Makes catalysts, starting with the muon catalyst.
desc.singulo.coffee: Coffee from a coffee maker, in a bottle. Drinking it gives Haste for 3 minutes and wakes you up, resetting the time until phantoms appear. The bottle is left over.
desc.singulo.coffee_maker: The laboratory break-room coffee maker. Add cocoa beans to brew three cups, then fill glass bottles from the pot. The ones in the laboratory already have coffee in them.
desc.singulo.cold_atoms: Atoms cooled close to absolute zero.
desc.singulo.collapsar_billet: Netherite wrapped in a degenerate-matter shell and soaked with jet condensate. Forge it in the Accretion Jet Forge to make a Collapsar Ingot.
desc.singulo.collapsar_ingot: Forged in a black hole jet. Used for Collapsar Lining, the Event Horizon Vault and the Wormhole Drone Beacon. Common tag: c:ingots/collapsar.
desc.singulo.collapsar_lining: A plate for casing positions on processing multiblocks (Degenerate Compactor, Casimir Cavity, Cryogenic Cooling Tower). Each one speeds processing by 5%, up to 2× at 20. The Holo Projector shows where it fits in gold.
desc.singulo.collapsar_parallel_cassette: Put it in the right-hand slot of the Jet Forge screen, or use it on any part of the forge, to process multiple batches of the same recipe together. The count is locked at the start; materials, coolant and power scale with it.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_1: Nine units of mass pressed together. The start of the compression chain.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2: Nine Lv1 blocks (eight if mixed). Fuel for the Degenerate Furnace.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed: Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks needs only 8 for Lv2.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1: A compressed block made only of metals.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2: Denser metal block, used for artificial star cores.
desc.singulo.compressor: Presses plates. In mass mode it turns any item into mass for compressed blocks and pellets.
desc.singulo.confinement_ring: A ring that cages black holes and singularities in a magnetic field, its meteoric-iron core gathering the flux.
desc.singulo.control_cabinet: A pale green steel cabinet with vents and a service door.
desc.singulo.control_unit: A restored ancient control unit with limited uses.
desc.singulo.coolant_cartridge: A canister holding 100 mB of liquid nitrogen. Right-click a machine to pour it in and get the empty cartridge back, so no pipes are needed. Cryogenic Turbines also take it in their input slot. The Precision Assembler uses it as is for cryogenic parts such as quantum computing modules. Assembly consumes the cartridge, including its container; no empty cartridge is returned.
desc.singulo.coolant_cladding: Teal steel cladding with reinforcing bands for cooling equipment.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing: Cooling Tower wall. Panels on the 5×5 rings can be swapped for I/O ports.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller: Goes in the middle of the front, second layer. The tower is 7–15 high; taller is faster.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_coolant_band: Coolant bands around the waist, every third layer.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension: Build the tower 10+ high to liquefy helium.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass: Window in the tower waist; the cores glow blue inside.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_grate: Grate closing the top; the vapour escapes through it.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_heat_exchange: Heat exchangers stacked up the middle of the tower.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_rim: The 5×5 rim at the top of the tower.
desc.singulo.copper_wire: Tier 1 power cable. Loses a little energy over distance.
desc.singulo.cosmic_frame: A heavy braced frame used for the bases and beams of cosmic containment facilities.
desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector: Collects cosmic-ray muons for free high up under open sky.
desc.singulo.cover_frame: A frame fitted to a cable or pipe; set a real block into it to take that block's look. Connections and flow stay the same. Breaking it takes off the block, then the frame, and leaves the cable.
desc.singulo.cracked_ruin_panel_slab: A half-height Cracked Ruin Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.cracked_ruin_panel_stairs: Stairs made from Cracked Ruin Panel.
desc.singulo.cracked_ruin_panel_wall: A Cracked Ruin Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.creative_catalyst: Creative only. A catalyst that never wears out. Right-click to change its tier.
desc.singulo.creative_energy_source: Creative only. Endless power pushed into every neighbour.
desc.singulo.creative_fluid_trash: Voids fluid piped into any face or poured from a container. Also works in fluid container filling slots.
desc.singulo.cryogenic_cooling_tower: A multiblock that liquefies nitrogen from the air, and helium too once it is 10 or more blocks tall.
desc.singulo.cryogenic_turbine: Recovers the power stored in liquid nitrogen by boiling it against a heat source next to it (up to 90% next to lava). It stores and moves power; it does not create any.
desc.singulo.crystal_memory: A storage medium with records etched in glass by light.
desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log: A copy of an observation log, usable in recipes.
desc.singulo.data_card_quantum_fragment: A copy of a quantum data fragment.
desc.singulo.decoded_record: Right-click to read it and add the next ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.deep_sea_collector: On the sea floor, water pressure presses minerals into Pressure Crystals. Works from 16 blocks deep; fastest at 48 (one a minute). No power needed.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor: Crushes matter into degenerate shells and reactor parts.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_anvil: The anvil at the centre of the Degenerate Compactor floor. It takes the blows of the ram from above.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_contro: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_frame: Frame along the 12 edges of the press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_plate: Plating; any plate can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_ram: Top centre; hammers down onto the anvil.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent: Cooling vents along the top row of each side.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_window: Middle of each side; watch the ram strike.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace: A large generator burning Lv2 blocks: 5 MFE/t on time crystals with default settings (25% on BE catalysts).
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll: Goes in the middle of a side, second layer from the bottom.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_fin: Radiators on either side of each furnace window.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_frame: The heavy frame along the 12 edges of the 5×5×7 furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston: Sits in the middle of the top and bottom faces and crushes the fuel.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_shell: Furnace plating. Any panel can be swapped for a Multiblock I/O Port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_tube: Copper pipes standing in the four inner corners of the furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_window: The middle column of each furnace side; shows the glowing core.
desc.singulo.degenerate_matter_shell: A dense shell of neutron-star matter.
desc.singulo.degenerate_nucleus: The uncollapsed gravity knot left at the heart of the Gravity Remnant. Used for the Singularity Encapsulator, Singularity Seed and Graviton Manipulator.
desc.singulo.degenerate_precursor: Compressed blocks pressed to the edge of degeneracy around a pressure-crystal seed. Shells need less rock with it.
desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample: A gravitational-anomaly sample altered by time.
desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap: Restore it in the Laser Cooler.
desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit: An ancient control unit worn by time.
desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed: A crystal seed destabilized by long dormancy.
desc.singulo.desk_monitor: A small monitor from a laboratory desk. Use it to open the factory monitor: power generated, used and stored by machines within 16 blocks, stalled machines and why, and how drones are doing. Each Server Rack placed beside it widens the range by 8 blocks (up to 4).
desc.singulo.dial_panel: A large analog meter visible from the operator desk.
desc.singulo.dimensional_pocket: Right-click to open your own 27-slot storage from anywhere. The contents survive death.
desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed: Guarded by the Horizon Warden. Awaken it in the encapsulator.
desc.singulo.drag_brake: A brake at the end of each section of the outer ring of the Sunken Reactor Sector. Pull it to stop the frame-drag floor of that section for good. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.drain_module: In the weapon module slot, the android recovers health equal to a tenth of the damage it deals.
desc.singulo.drone_kit: A set of parts and shell plates. A Drone Station uses one each time it prints a cargo drone.
desc.singulo.drone_memory: A crystal memory smaller than an android’s, holding the design of a four-rotor cargo drone (rotor type). Put it in a Drone Station to print rotor drones (it is not used up). Dropped by guard docks in any facility.
desc.singulo.drone_memory_gravity: The design of a cargo drone that floats on an anti-gravity field. Put it in a Drone Station to print drones whose four bits carry crates on tractor beams (1.25× the rotor type’s speed). It is not used up. Rarely dropped by guard docks in the Culture Facility and the Underground Android Laboratory.
desc.singulo.drone_memory_jet: The design of a cargo drone with twin jets. Put it in a Drone Station to print the fastest drones (1.6× the rotor type). It is not used up. Dropped by guard docks in the Research Building and higher facilities.
desc.singulo.drone_phase_upgrade: Put it in the slot inside a Drone Station’s frame (below the Production Upgrades) to let its drones take shortcuts straight through walls and roofs. They glow violet while passing through.
desc.singulo.drone_port: Put in an empty packing crate and cargo, choose a destination (another port with the same owner) and send: it packs the cargo, pays the power and calls a nearby drone. The roof hatch opens and the crate is handed up. Arriving crates are unpacked automatically. Power: 2,000 FE plus 50 FE per block. It can also auto-send to a set destination once cargo reaches a threshold. Drones find their way around walls through open space.
desc.singulo.drone_station: Prints cargo drones of its memory’s type (rotor, jet or anti-gravity) from a Drone Crystal Memory, Drone Kits and power (20,000 FE each; each Production Upgrade adds one, up to 3). Drones wait above it and carry cargo for Drone Ports within 64 blocks. A Phase Shift Upgrade lets them fly through walls, and a Shield Permit on the right rail limits who can use it.
desc.singulo.echo_chapter: A passage of records left behind when the Awakened Echo Sentinel unravels. It looks like part of a page. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.echo_projector: Projects the Echo Sentinel. The more projectors remain, the less damage the sentinel takes. Breaks by hand.
desc.singulo.echo_resonator: Copies echo shards using a template shard.
desc.singulo.electrolyzer: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
desc.singulo.emergency_light: Laboratory emergency light. It glows red only while main power is down.
desc.singulo.empty_black_hole_vessel: A vessel for holding a tiny black hole.
desc.singulo.empty_coolant_cartridge: A steel canister that holds 100 mB of liquid nitrogen. Right-click the cooling tower controller, or process it in the tower, to fill it.
desc.singulo.energy_drink: A yellow can of energy drink from the laboratory's vending machine. Drinking it gives Haste II for 2 minutes.
desc.singulo.entangled_element: A pair of elements with entangled quantum states.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_chapter: A passage of records that surfaces after the Ergosphere Leviathan sinks: the rest of the second reactor's log. Also used for the Awakened Ergosphere Core.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring: Goes in a slot of the P-Reactor core controller and extracts exotic matter from a fast-spinning core.
desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield: Protects a 32-block radius from explosions, griefing and hostile spawns.
desc.singulo.exotic_matter: Matter with negative energy density. Fuels gravity tech.
desc.singulo.explorer_compass: Right-click to point at the nearest ruin of the chosen kind. Sneak-use to change the kind.
desc.singulo.facility_light: Laboratory ceiling light. It shines white only while the facility has power.
desc.singulo.facility_reconstructor: Use on the core of a cleared facility generated by an older version to rebuild it as the current facility. Terrain, builds and inventories in the area are overwritten and cannot be restored.
desc.singulo.factory_conveyor: A belt conveyor from an old-civilization factory. While running, it carries whatever stands on it. The Foundry Overseer runs them during its fight.
desc.singulo.factory_line: A printing bay along the walls of the Android Laboratory AI core. While running it shields the Foundry Overseer and prints mass-produced androids. Breakable by hand.
desc.singulo.fluid_canister: Holds up to 1,000 mB of any liquid or gas. Right-click a machine to fill it from the output tank or pour it into the input tank. Carries hydrogen (Electrolyzer to Particle Accelerator), helium (Compressor to Cooling Tower) and liquid helium without pipes.
desc.singulo.fluid_capsule: A pressure vessel that carries up to 64,000 mB of one fluid by drone. Reaches 160 blocks.
desc.singulo.fluid_drone_port: Fills fluid capsules from its send tank and sends them by drone to other fluid ports with the same owner. Arrived fluid empties into its receive tank.
desc.singulo.fluid_pipe: Carries fluids and gases pushed into it, up to 2,000 mB per tick.
desc.singulo.fluid_pump: Attach the copper intake to a tank. Supply FE on any face. The pump draws power only as it delivers fluid. On Singulo cables, other devices receive power first. Right-click to choose output faces.
desc.singulo.food_cartridge: A paste container for the Food Printer. Holds up to 64 of one kind of paste, and can switch kinds once empty.
desc.singulo.food_printer: Refills Food Cartridges with the protein, carbohydrate or sweet paste that runs short from the ingredients in each row, then prints the space food you pick, layer by layer, on power. A nozzle builds the food up inside the glass chamber.
desc.singulo.frame_drag_floor: Floor of the outer ring of the Sunken Reactor Sector. Spacetime dragged along by the spin of the dead reactor carries anything on it the way the arrows point, even while sneaking. Stops once the brake of its section is pulled. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.frost_module: In the weapon module slot, slows anything hit for 2 seconds.
desc.singulo.fruit_gel_cube: Four layers of jelly. Edible when full, and heals a little.
desc.singulo.fulgurite: Natural high-purity quartz glass fused by lightning. Used to make optical lattice substrates.
desc.singulo.fulgurite_block: Sand fused by a lightning strike. Break it for fulgurite.
desc.singulo.genesis_core: The heart of an engine that makes a universe from energy. Surround it with 8 frames and 12 pylons, use a Primordial Seed and pour in 1.5 TFE to begin. Once born, the universe turns power into mass (items).
desc.singulo.genesis_frame: Placed level with the Genesis Core in an octagon three blocks out (four on the axes, four on the 2-2 diagonals).
desc.singulo.genesis_pylon: Stacked three high on each diagonal frame of the Genesis Engine; they focus power into the newborn universe.
desc.singulo.glowing_bismuth_crystal: Bismuth crystal mixed with phosphor so it glows. A building block.
desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t: The only tank that holds dark matter. Keeps its contents when broken.
desc.singulo.gravitational_wave_detector: Points toward the nearest gravitational anomaly.
desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator: The full gravity tool. Hold left-click to use; while levitating, charge with right-click and release to throw.
desc.singulo.gravity_boots: No fall damage. Jump while touching a wall in mid-air to kick off it (three times before landing).
desc.singulo.gravity_chapter: A passage of records left in the collapse of the Awakened Gravity Remnant, etched with a memory of weight. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer: A component that suppresses gravitational fluctuations.
desc.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver: Takes power from cables and feeds every panel touching it and everything joined to those (low- and high-gravity panels, zero-gravity blocks and built Rayleigh sky panels). It stores no power and takes only what the joined panels use, so they work only while power keeps coming. It stays light even with huge numbers of panels. When power runs short, only the nearest panels it can pay for work. Right-click to see how many are active and the power they use.
desc.singulo.guardian_core: The seal in the floor of a ruin boss room. It wakes the ruin's guardian when a challenger enters. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.halo_collector: Gathers dark matter near a running core.
desc.singulo.handbook: Right-click to open. Explains goals, machines, multiblocks and shows your progress.
desc.singulo.hawking_collector: Goes in a slot of the P-Reactor core controller. Collects one H-Condensate every 5 minutes while the core is light (catalyst mode; harvest mode keeps it there).
desc.singulo.heavy_strike_module: In the weapon module slot, finishing moves (such as the crimson flash, the railgun and heavenly thunder) deal 2.2x damage. Other moves stay as they are.
desc.singulo.helium_cartridge: A cartridge holding 250 mB of liquid helium. Right-click a machine to pour it in; the Accretion Jet Forge drains it automatically from its material slots.
desc.singulo.high_gravity_panel: When powered, standing on it raises your gravity 2.5x until you next land. Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.holo_projector: Use on a multiblock controller to project its shape and list missing blocks. Sneak-use to change size.
desc.singulo.honeycomb_cake: A cake topped with honey hexagons. Eating it gives Speed.
desc.singulo.horizon_bus: The tier 5 cable, needed to ignite the reactor.
desc.singulo.horizon_chapter: A passage of records found in the Awakened Horizon Warden's wreck, naming what the warden was guarding. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.horizon_duct: A thick stage 5 main with no transfer limit.
desc.singulo.horizon_vault: Stores a practically unlimited amount (about 9.2 quintillion) of one item inside a small black hole. Insert and take by hand, or connect hoppers and pipes. Breaking it keeps the contents.
desc.singulo.hydrogen_fuel_cell: A stage 1 generator that makes power from hydrogen and oxygen. It returns 60% of the power the Electrolyzer put into the hydrogen: 4.8 FE per mB, up to 240 FE/t, using 1 mB of oxygen per 2 mB of hydrogen. Right-click with an empty hand to see its status.
desc.singulo.impact_generator_panel: Landing on it causes no fall damage. Stores 1,000 FE per block fallen (up to 20,000 FE) and powers connected gravity panels.
desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet: Hold right-click to levitate or pull one small mob. Sneak-use to switch modes.
desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer: Stops explosions from breaking blocks within 16 blocks.
desc.singulo.intact_ruin_glass: An intact ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.jet_collector: Goes in a slot of the P-Reactor core controller and collects jet condensate from the core’s jets.
desc.singulo.jet_condensate: Condensed particles from a relativistic jet.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_collector: Centre of the irradiation chamber floor. Receives the cooled product.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_collimator: Three rings of radius 5, 4 and 3 that squeeze the jet step by step into a thin white beam.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_confinement_coil: Two radius-7 rings around the black hole. They twist the magnetic field of the inflow and drive jets out of both poles.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_core: The brain of the Accretion Jet Forge, set into the front edge of the plinth under the core. Insert a Singularity Seed and ignite it to form the forging black hole.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_foundation: The foundation under the facility. Any foundation block can be swapped for a multiblock port to feed power, materials and coolant and to send out products.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_heat_sink: Forms the cup that catches the opposite jet and the plate that stops the beam behind the material.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_levitator: Centre of the irradiation chamber ceiling. Its gravity field holds the material in the beam path.
desc.singulo.jet_forge_truss: Core beams, ring supports and the irradiation chamber frame.
desc.singulo.keraunos_tower: Builds up 1,000,000 FE and hurls artificial lightning at the nearest lightning rod within 16 blocks. Sand under the rod turns into fulgurite. Three firing modes: manual, redstone and auto (sneak-right-click to switch).
desc.singulo.kiln: Fires ceramics and boards. Oxygen makes it hotter.
desc.singulo.lab_door: The white twin sliding doors of the laboratory's private rooms and kitchen. Right-click to slide them open into the walls; they close by themselves once no one is passing through. They stay open while powered by redstone. Cannot be crafted.
desc.singulo.lab_frame: Dark steel framing used for the laboratory's pillars and door frames.
desc.singulo.lab_glass: Clear partition glass from the laboratory.
desc.singulo.lab_panel: White wall panelling from the underground android laboratory. The androids still polish it spotless.
desc.singulo.lab_panel_lined: Laboratory panelling with a blue-grey band.
desc.singulo.lab_panel_slab: A half-height Lab Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.lab_panel_wall: A Lab Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.lab_rayleigh_panel: A sky projection panel in the laboratory ceiling. Once facility power returns, its underside shows a cloudless midday sky and lights the space below like sunlight (daylight detectors underneath read midday). Panels side by side join into one wide sky. Leaves nothing when broken.
desc.singulo.lab_reactor_console: Central reactor control panel. Use it to restart the reactor and restore facility power.
desc.singulo.lab_reactor_core: The central reactor core. It glows bright cyan once power returns.
desc.singulo.lab_terminal: A terminal left in the laboratory. Use it to read the records left behind.
desc.singulo.lab_tile_slab: A half-height Lab Floor Tile. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.lab_tile_stairs: Stairs made from Lab Floor Tile.
desc.singulo.lab_tile_wall: A Lab Floor Tile wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.large_battery_fluid_capsule: A fluid capsule with a large battery. Reaches 3,160 blocks.
desc.singulo.large_battery_packing_crate: A packing crate with a large battery. Reaches up to 3,160 blocks.
desc.singulo.laser_cooler: Laser-cools atoms into cold atoms, lattices and condensates.
desc.singulo.low_gravity_panel: When powered, standing on it cuts your gravity to a fifth until you next land (less fall damage too). Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle: A bottle that traps strangelets in a magnetic field. Use it on leaking strange matter to contain and collect it.
desc.singulo.magnetic_key: Opens or seals a magnetic-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole: A theoretical particle born in about 1 of 1000 collisions.
desc.singulo.mass_pellet: Packed mass fuel for the P-Reactor.
desc.singulo.meteor_compass: Right-click to point at the nearest meteorite core not yet mined. Once that core is mined, the needle spins again.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_chunk: Natural iron-nickel alloy inside a meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron. Found only in meteor craters.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_ingot: A naturally magnetic alloy of iron and nickel. Metal from the stars, now resting in your hand.
desc.singulo.meteorite_core: A fused lump of meteoric iron and stardust, one at the heart of each meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron and stardust. The Meteor Compass points to it.
desc.singulo.meteorite_crust: The burnt, melted shell of a crater meteorite. Only shells still in their crater slowly grow stardust clusters.
desc.singulo.metric_drive: Switch between low gravity, flight and high gravity.
desc.singulo.micro_black_hole_vessel: Holds a tiny black hole. Bends light around it.
desc.singulo.mimic_panel: A mimic panel with colored lines showing pipes and pumps.
desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade: Insert into a machine's monopole slot: ×2 speed and 50% better power efficiency.
desc.singulo.mossy_ruin_panel_slab: A half-height Mossy Ruin Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.mossy_ruin_panel_stairs: Stairs made from Mossy Ruin Panel.
desc.singulo.mossy_ruin_panel_wall: A Mossy Ruin Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.multiblock_port: Replaces a plain shell panel of a multiblock (not frames or functional parts; for the accelerator, either side of the controller). Cables and pipes reach the controller, and outputs and generated power are pushed out automatically.
desc.singulo.muon_bundle: A bundle of muons, the base of muon catalysts.
desc.singulo.muon_catalyst: Tier 2 catalyst with a lifetime. Leaves a spent catalyst when used up.
desc.singulo.muon_fusion_reactor: A stage 2 generator that runs on muon catalysts and water (deuterium), 4 kFE/t. Catalysts wear twice as fast: a fresh one lasts 10 minutes, a used one for half its remaining lifetime, then comes out spent.
desc.singulo.neutrino_observatory: Keeps scanning a wide area and shows ores and ruins to nearby players. Use to toggle.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner: Shows the outlines of nearby ruin blocks and ores through terrain for 10 seconds. Uses power. Sensitivity modules reveal deeper ores.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner_module_2: Use with a Neutrino Scanner in your other hand, or on an observatory, to reach sensitivity 2: gold, diamond and emerald show up.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner_module_3: Raises sensitivity to 3: ancient debris and ores that need a diamond pickaxe show up.
desc.singulo.nihonium_frame: A sturdy frame clad in nihonium.
desc.singulo.nihonium_ingot: A heavy, dense ingot of nihonium. An element born in the accelerator becomes the foundation of your next machine.
desc.singulo.nihonium_plate: Nihonium pressed into a thin plate.
desc.singulo.nuclear_pasta: Confined layers of nuclear matter made in the existing Accretion Jet Forge. No new accumulator is required.
desc.singulo.nutrient_bar: A printed nutrient bar. Quick to eat.
desc.singulo.observation_log: Observation records left by the old civilization.
desc.singulo.operator_chair: A dark green swivel chair for a control-room operator.
desc.singulo.operator_desk: A sloped desk with selector switches and small meters.
desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate: A substrate of atoms arranged in an optical lattice.
desc.singulo.overclock_chip: Install in the machine upgrade slot to change speed and power use. Shares a slot with the monopole.
desc.singulo.packing_crate: A crate for cargo sent by drone. Reaches up to 160 blocks. Right-click a packed crate to unpack it.
desc.singulo.paper_stack: Papers left piled on a desk.
desc.singulo.particle_accelerator: Collides particles into muon bundles and rare monopoles.
desc.singulo.pasta_accumulator: A 7×9×7 facility storing 8 TFE, with 2 GFE/t input and output. Charging closes its press plates and turns the nuclear pasta from drops to rods to sheets; discharge flows through the corner conductors. Its two ports can each be set to input, output or both. Items that take power, placed in the charge slot of its screen, are charged and come out in the next slot when full.
desc.singulo.pasta_conductor: Wound bus bars at the four corners of the Nuclear Pasta Accumulator.
desc.singulo.pasta_laminate: Layered plates that form the top and bottom of the Nuclear Pasta Accumulator.
desc.singulo.peltier_cooler: Runs current through thermoelectric elements to freeze water (a thermoelectric generator in reverse). 1,000 mB of water makes 1 ice.
desc.singulo.penrose_reactor: Draws energy from a spinning black hole.
desc.singulo.phase_sync_plate: A component that synchronizes atomic oscillations.
desc.singulo.piercing_module: In the weapon module slot, ignores 40% of the target armor protection.
desc.singulo.portable_android_printer: A briefcase printer. Put in a memory and android kits, then right-click the ground to print an android there. The android follows you.
desc.singulo.portable_android_printer_2: An improved Portable Android Printer. It holds three sets of memory and kits, and each print uses the next set. Choose the next set on its screen.
desc.singulo.power_conduit: A conduit carrying power from the central reactor. It glows cyan once power returns.
desc.singulo.precision_actuator: A precision drive unit of the old civilization.
desc.singulo.precision_assembler: Assembles most parts and machines from tier 2 on.
desc.singulo.pressure_crystal: A hard violet crystal that a Deep-Sea Pressure Collector presses from minerals with deep-sea water pressure. The Gravity Remnant drops it too.
desc.singulo.pressure_glass: The thick viewing glass ringing the Final Lab dome and the Sunken Reactor Sector sphere. Sealed and unbreakable, like the pressure hull.
desc.singulo.pressure_hull: The two-block-thick steel shell around the laboratory's rooms and corridors. Sealed and unbreakable until the overseer AI falls, and harder than obsidian even after.
desc.singulo.primordial_seed: A seed made by running the ignition log in the Chapter of the Vortex backwards. Use it on a Genesis Core to begin the birth of a universe.
desc.singulo.printed_steak: A steak printed down to its sear marks and marbling.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_light: A white panel with a softly glowing strip. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel: An unweathered white panel from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel_slab: A half-height Pristine Ruin Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel_stairs: Stairs made from Pristine Ruin Panel.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel_wall: A Pristine Ruin Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_pillar: A white pillar from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tile_slab: A half-height Pristine Ruin Tile. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tile_stairs: Stairs made from Pristine Ruin Tile.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tile_wall: A Pristine Ruin Tile wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tiles: Unweathered white tiles from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.probe_station: Sends probes to discovered ruins to fetch loot.
desc.singulo.procedure_card: Records up to eight steps and what they produce, in the procedure mode of a work console's Record tab. Steps can insert, extract, mine, harvest, fell, breed, shear, milk, cull or use a block (levers and buttons). The places are stored on the card, so it works in a recipe rack row without a Work Location Card. Mining needs a Mining Upgrade and felling a Felling Upgrade.
desc.singulo.quantum_android_workbench: The top Android Workbench. Androids craft twenty times as fast as on a vanilla crafting table, and the holding box has 81 slots. Androids use 30% of the usual charge per craft. Used the same way as the Android Workbench.
desc.singulo.quantum_computing_module: A computing module that uses quantum states.
desc.singulo.quantum_data_fragment: A fragment of quantum-state analysis data.
desc.singulo.quantum_heat_engine: Generates power from the quantum effects of a catalyst. Higher-tier catalysts give more output.
desc.singulo.quantum_key: Opens or seals a quantum-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.rapid_strike_module: In the weapon module slot, cuts the wait between moves to three quarters. Each hit stays as strong.
desc.singulo.raw_meteoric_iron: Raw meteoric metal containing iron and nickel.
desc.singulo.rayleigh_panel: A sky projection panel for ceilings. Powered by a panel receiver (20 FE/t each, shared across all joined panels), its underside shows a midday sky with no clouds or sun and lights the space below like sunlight (light level 15; daylight detectors underneath read midday). It never turns to night; without power it is dark as midnight. Panels side by side lose their edges and join into one wide sky. Made from the Rayleigh Sky Panel Blueprint.
desc.singulo.reactor_core_controller: Placed 5 below the core centre. Ignite the reactor from its screen.
desc.singulo.reactor_extraction_port: Power/fuel port for the reactor. Replaces any ring shell block (not the gyro drives).
desc.singulo.reactor_gyro_drive: Placed where the reactor rings cross.
desc.singulo.reactor_mass_alarm: Replaces a shell on a reactor ring. Emits redstone when the core reaches its mass limit, stronger near collapse.
desc.singulo.reactor_shell: Shell of the reactor's three rings.
desc.singulo.reactor_stabilizer: Coils at the 45° points of the reactor rings.
desc.singulo.recipe_card: Record a recipe on it in a work console's Record tab and place it in a recipe rack. Sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Hold Shift to see what it makes.
desc.singulo.reinforced_ruin_glass: A window set into the containment pillars of the Sunken Reactor Sector, built to survive the reactor's blasts. Very hard and blast-proof.
desc.singulo.relocation_wrench: Sneak-use to relocate processing machines, generators, energy storage and catalyst devices with their items, fluids, energy and settings.
desc.singulo.rgb_dye_station: Put red, green, blue, white and black dyes in their slots to turn them into ink (8 units per dye, up to 64 of each), then dye anything dyeable, such as leather armor or android decorations, any color you pick on the color wheel and brightness bar. The ink used depends on the color: a pure hue uses only its colored inks, a gray only white and black (up to 4 units of each). Breaking it drops its dyes and as many dyes as its ink can make again.
desc.singulo.room_light: The ceiling light of a laboratory private room. It glows only while it gets a redstone signal (flip the lever beside it on the ceiling). Needs no facility power. Made from the Lighting Blueprint.
desc.singulo.ruin_android_fabricator: Prints androids onto its bed and sends them out. Defeat them all for a 50% chance at a compact crystal memory of their design.
desc.singulo.ruin_cache: Holds ruin loot and refills some days after it is emptied (not if moved). Hoppers and pipes cannot take from it.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp: An ancient lamp that still glows.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_amber: An amber ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_crimson: A crimson ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_verdant: A green ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_violet: A violet ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_panel_slab: A half-height Ruin Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.ruin_panel_wall: A Ruin Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.ruin_relay: Relays deep in each wing of the antechambers of the Final Lab and the Sunken Reactor Sector. Touch one to start it (not while security drones or ruin androids remain nearby). Some are guarded by a sub-boss, one charges from items dropped into its vortex pit, and one drains the flooded wing when started. Starting every relay in the facility opens the bulkhead before the boss room; until then its guardian will not wake. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.seal_console: The seal of the Final Lab. Touch it to wake the Horizon Warden.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_1: Opens with a Magnetic Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_2: Opens with a Quantum Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_3: Opens with a Temporal Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_4: Opens with a Singularity Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_record: Right-click to read it and add a sealed ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.sentinel_core: The record crystal from the Echo Sentinel's chest. Built into the Echo Resonator, Time Crystal Incubator and Probe Station.
desc.singulo.server_rack: A laboratory server. Its lights blink while powered.
desc.singulo.settings_card: Copies machine side and auto-eject settings, plus the recipe choice between machines of the same type. For a P-Reactor, copies the spin target and feed interval.
desc.singulo.shield_permit: Put it in a shield tower: only registered players may build, break or take items inside. In an Android Assembly Station, registered players may also control the android, and the android attacks anyone not registered. In a Drone Station, only registered players may open its screen. Use to register yourself; use on a player to register them and you. Anyone can break the emitter crown.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_body: Corners of the 3×3 body and the base of the spire.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_coil: Inner 3×3 of the upper plinth layer.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_core: The brain of the Event Horizon Shield Tower. Goes in the front middle of the second plinth layer.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_crown: The top of the tower; the dome is cast from here.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_plinth: The 5×5 two-layer plinth; its upper edge takes I/O ports.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_waveguide: Middle of each body face and midway up the spire; shows the rising energy.
desc.singulo.singularity_key: Opens or seals a singularity-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.singularity_seed: Put it in a slot of the P-Reactor core controller and ignite it to make a black hole core. It also ignites the Accretion Jet Forge and opens the core of the Suspension Reservoir, Nuclear Pasta Accumulator and Tidal Spindle.
desc.singulo.smes_cell: Superconducting magnetic energy storage that holds a large amount of power. Right-click to open its screen. Items that take power, placed in the charge slot of its screen, are charged and come out in the next slot when full.
desc.singulo.spent_bose_condensate_catal: A Bose condensate catalyst that has lost its activity.
desc.singulo.spent_muon_catalyst: A muon catalyst that has lost its activity.
desc.singulo.spent_singularity_core: A used-up Singularity Core. About 25% can be recovered as a lower-tier catalyst.
desc.singulo.spent_time_crystal_catalyst: A time crystal catalyst that has lost its activity.
desc.singulo.spiral_pasta: Spiral pasta with tomato sauce. Eating it gives Haste.
desc.singulo.sports_drink: A white can of sports drink from the laboratory's vending machine. Drinking it gives Regeneration for 15 seconds.
desc.singulo.stardust: Cosmic grains carrying rare isotopes. The raw material for cold atoms.
desc.singulo.stardust_cluster: Crystals of cosmic grains that grow on meteorite crust. Break them for stardust.
desc.singulo.steel_blend: A blend of iron and carbon.
desc.singulo.steel_ingot: A sturdy structural metal. Unassuming, but a factory can grow from a single bar.
desc.singulo.steel_plate: Steel pressed into a thin plate.
desc.singulo.strange_matter: Ultra-dense matter left by strangelets. Worth 100 mass and usable for degenerate shells.
desc.singulo.strangelet: Converts nearby blocks into strange matter. Contain it with a Magnetic Bottle.
desc.singulo.striped_ruin_panel: Ancient panel with a long-dead light band.
desc.singulo.superconducting_coil: A coil with zero electrical resistance.
desc.singulo.superfluid_conduit: A clear stage 4 conduit that moves fluid as a frictionless superfluid: 512,000 mB per tick.
desc.singulo.survey_glasses: Worn on the head (use it, or put it in the helmet slot). While worn, the places recorded on the area card or work location card in your hand are outlined (with only the first corner of an area recorded, the area up to the block you look at is previewed). The icons over working androids, showing what they are doing, are only visible while wearing them.
desc.singulo.suspension_crown: The octagonal crown of the Suspension Reservoir. The glowing ring on its underside holds the fluid up.
desc.singulo.suspension_reservoir: A 7×9×7 facility that hangs 16,000,000 mB of liquids or gases from its octagonal crown as a single drop. Its two ports can each be set to input, output or both.
desc.singulo.suspension_strut: A slender strut that lifts the crown of the Suspension Reservoir.
desc.singulo.temporal_key: Opens or seals a temporal-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.terminus_record: The four chapters bound back together with singularity power: the last page. Use it on the Seal Console of the Final Lab to wake what slept in the time field. Leave and the record is returned.
desc.singulo.thermocouple_module: An element that converts heat differences into power.
desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator: Place it between something hot and something cold to generate power. Your first generator. Magma block + blue ice gives about 76 FE/t without melting.
desc.singulo.tidal_draw_ring: Forms the core drum and draw rings of the Tidal Spindle, narrowing the thread.
desc.singulo.tidal_filament: Luminous filament stretched by black-hole tidal forces. Combined with Collapsar material, it stitches open a traversable wormhole.
desc.singulo.tidal_spindle: A 7×8×15 facility. Form its core with a Singularity Seed and 10 GFE, then stretch matter into wound filament using tidal forces. Processing needs 20 MFE/t and liquid helium. It can also stretch wool into string, iron into chains, leather into phantom membranes and more. Reserved work survives stops and unloaded chunks.
desc.singulo.tidal_spindle_cradle: Bearing stands that hold the spool of the Tidal Spindle.
desc.singulo.tiled_ruin_panel_slab: A half-height Tiled Ruin Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.tiled_ruin_panel_stairs: Stairs made from Tiled Ruin Panel.
desc.singulo.tiled_ruin_panel_wall: A Tiled Ruin Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst: Tier 4 catalyst used by most advanced devices.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator: Grows time crystal catalysts. Underpowering lowers their purity.
desc.singulo.tipler_bearing: Top and bottom centre; carries the cylinder axle.
desc.singulo.tipler_core: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×9 housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_cylinder: Speeds up time within 16 blocks: machines and crops nearby run twice as fast.
desc.singulo.tipler_frame: Frame along the 12 edges of the housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_holder: Either side of each window, middle layer.
desc.singulo.tipler_housing: Housing; any panel can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.tipler_window: Five-high slit in each side; shows the spinning cylinder.
desc.singulo.trash_bin: A laboratory trash bin. The androids empty it every day.
desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic: Clay, sand, Nether quartz and bone meal (or limestone powder), ready to be fired into white ceramic.
desc.singulo.vacuum_jacketed_pipe: A stage 2 pipe wrapped in a vacuum insulation jacket: 32,000 mB per tick. Connects to pipes of any tier.
desc.singulo.vending_machine: A laboratory drinks vending machine (two blocks tall). Hold emeralds and press the button under a column to buy Canned Soda (1), Sports Drink (1) or Energy Drink (2). The ones in the laboratory start working once facility power is restored.
desc.singulo.void_collector: Place it in the End over open void to gather one Void Dust a minute. Needs no power.
desc.singulo.void_dust: Dust condensed from the fluctuations of empty space, gathered only above the End void. Steadies space in singularity tech.
desc.singulo.warden_breaker_module: In the weapon module slot, a guard android joins fights against bosses (ruin guardians, the Horizon Warden and the like) and deals 1.8x damage to them. It also takes their hits. Guards without it stay out of boss fights.
desc.singulo.welded_hatch: Steel plates welded shut over the lab's supply shaft. Sealed until the lab's AI is defeated; after that it can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite: The white ceramic used for casings and circuit boards.
desc.singulo.white_glass_panel: A see-through panel in the White Panel style.
desc.singulo.white_glass_panel_slab: A half-height White Glass Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.white_glass_panel_stairs: Stairs made from White Glass Panel.
desc.singulo.white_light_panel: A white panel that glows brightly (light 15).
desc.singulo.white_panel: A clean, seamless white panel for your own buildings.
desc.singulo.white_panel_slab: A half-height White Panel. Two make a full block.
desc.singulo.white_panel_wall: A White Panel wall that connects like a fence.
desc.singulo.white_sliding_door: White twin sliding doors modeled on the laboratory doors. Right-click to slide them open; they close by themselves once no one is passing through, and stay open while powered by redstone. Set into a wall, the doors slide away inside it.
desc.singulo.white_star_glass_panel: A see-through white panel with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.work_location_card: Sneak-use on a block to record its position (one card is split off a stack). Sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Use a card holding a work console on a supply port, delivery port or recipe rack to link it. Hold Shift to see the recorded block.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor: Keeps nearby chunks loaded while fed a catalyst.
desc.singulo.wormhole_drone_beacon: Place one near both mouths of a wormhole and drones fly through it to deliver to ports in another dimension, then return the same way. The far side needs no Drone Station. Within one dimension, drones also use it as a shortcut when that is shorter.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator: Creates a pair of wormhole mouths from 100 MFE/t for 10 s.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_coil: Equator, either side of each window.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_core: Front middle of the second ring from the bottom of the sphere.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_focuser: Top and bottom centre of the sphere.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_port: Replaces a generator shell. Feeds power to the core and pushes finished mouths out.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_shell: The outer shell of the Wormhole Generator sphere. Any shell block can be replaced with a multiblock I/O port.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_window: Middle of each face at the equator; shows the vortex.
desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth: Links to its twin. Runs on exotic matter; when it runs dry it closes and waits for more. Stays open for 5 minutes without fuel when first placed.
desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth_casing: An open frame that holds a stabilized throat. One per wormhole mouth.
desc.singulo.wormhole_port: Within 8 blocks of a mouth, links machines to the port with the same number (0-127) near the twin mouth. A mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports by throat size, nearest first. Glows while active.
desc.singulo.wormhole_seam_upgrade: Use on an existing wormhole mouth to install. When both upgraded ends are open, walk through the square opening above it and come out at the same spot in the far opening, like a Nether portal. Logistics remain available, and you never land somewhere unsafe.
desc.singulo.wormhole_stabilizer: Stabilizes an unstable wormhole mouth with exotic matter so that it can be placed.
desc.singulo.zero_gravity_block: When powered by a panel receiver, the space above it (5 blocks at first) becomes weightless: hold jump to drift up, sneak to drift down, and there is no fall damage. 30 FE/t each. A zero-gravity control box changes the height. Androids fly inside it and can reach any height. Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.zero_gravity_controller: Attached to zero-gravity blocks, it sets the weightless height for all the joined blocks (right-click to raise it by one, sneak-right-click to lower it; no limit). Boxes on the same group share one height, and a broken box keeps its height as an item. Each extra block of height multiplies the power of every zero-gravity block by 1.4.
desc.singulo.zinc_ingot: An ingot of zinc. A small ingot with the promise of a new element.
ending.singulo.archivist: — The Archivist's voice: "Beyond the last page. Thank you for letting me read it."
ending.singulo.line.1: Once, a civilization tried to turn all mass into energy.
ending.singulo.line.2: The reactor granted that wish: the cities, the mountains, the sea. Only the anomaly and the records remained.
ending.singulo.line.3: You read those records and lit the same fire. And you never forgot to stop when it was time to stop.
ending.singulo.line.4: And now the energy has become mass again, then stars, then a galaxy.
ending.singulo.line.5: Look up at the night sky. That light is the universe you made.
ending.singulo.supporter_controls: ← / → to browse supporters · Esc to close
gui.singulo.anchor.confirm_embed: Use again to embed. It cannot be removed
gui.singulo.android.chem.hint: Click with a chemical tank (Mekanism) or similar to fill or draw
gui.singulo.android.collect.hint: Picks up items lying nearby, such as drops from defeated enemies. Items thrown by players are left alone
gui.singulo.android.decor.0.hint: Ribbon, hair flower, beret, headdress, cat ears, a hat, a hair extension or a tiara
gui.singulo.android.decor.1.hint: Cape, scarf, fairy wings, necktie or necklace
gui.singulo.android.decor.2.hint: Paperback, bouquet, teacup, umbrella, lantern or broom (held only while idle)
gui.singulo.android.decor.4.hint: Waist ribbon, apron, brooch or cat tail
gui.singulo.android.decor.dye: Dye them with dyes on a crafting table
gui.singulo.android.follow.hint: Click to switch between "Follow only" (never fights) and "Follow & escort" (fights nearby enemies). Also changes the station setting.
gui.singulo.android.log.alarm: Spotted a group of %2$s (%1$s and others) and raised the alarm
gui.singulo.android.log.empty.1: Defeated enemies and alarms show up here
gui.singulo.android.say.idle.6: I'll do my best today too!
gui.singulo.android.sort.hint: Sort the carried items and backpack contents (stacks the same items together)
gui.singulo.android.stall.full: Storage is full; can't put items away
gui.singulo.android.stall.missing: Not enough materials in the stockpile
gui.singulo.android.stall.no_power: The station is out of power; can't charge
gui.singulo.android.stall.no_target: Nothing to work on in the area right now
gui.singulo.android.stall.protected: A protected block; can't break it
gui.singulo.android.stash.going: Going to put things in a nearby box
gui.singulo.android.stash.hint: Go and put the carried items and backpack contents in a nearby box (chest, barrel, shulker box, supply port or work console)
gui.singulo.android.stash.none: No box nearby to put things in (within 12 blocks)
gui.singulo.android.store.1: Store pickups: work console and supply ports first
gui.singulo.android.store.hint: The android deposits only items it picks up. If the preferred storage is unavailable, it tries the other kind. Click to switch.
gui.singulo.android.tank.hint: Click with a bucket or other container to fill or draw
gui.singulo.android.work.hint: Whether this android may be given work (automation). When off, it is never offered for work.
gui.singulo.android_station.escort.hint: While following, it also fights enemies near you.
While following, it only tags along and never fights (not even when hit).
gui.singulo.android_station.leader.hint: Click to change whom it follows (when that player is away it follows the owner, or else the nearest registered player).
gui.singulo.android_station.locked: You are not on this station's permit
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.0.hint: Waits by the station and fights enemies that come close.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.1.hint: Roams within 16 blocks of the station and fights the enemies it finds.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.2.hint: Follows its owner (the buttons below choose whether it fights nearby enemies). Recharges while walking with you if you carry a wireless charger.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.3.hint: Walks the route below (Work Location Cards) in order and fights enemies nearby. Calls idle allies when a fight starts, and when it spots a group of enemies or a boss, the station gives a redstone signal and the owner is told.
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.dwell: How long to stop and look around at each point. Click to change
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.night: Patrol only at night (waiting by the station in the day) or all the time. Click to switch
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.order: After the last point, go back to the first one (Loop) or come back the same way (Back & forth). Click to switch
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.hint: With a shield permit inside, only the owner and registered players can open the station and android screens, and the android treats anyone else as an enemy and attacks them. You can also choose which registered player it follows.
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.membe: Only the owner and %s registered can use it
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.none: No permit: anyone can use it
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.other: Anyone else is treated as an enemy and attacked
gui.singulo.android_station.recall.hint: Click: recall the android shown. Shift-click: recall every android from the stations you can use within %s blocks.
gui.singulo.android_station.retreat.hint: Below this share of health it returns to the station to repair and recharge.
gui.singulo.android_station.route.hint: Patrol route: place Work Location Cards and the androids visit those places from left to right (up to 8), standing on top of each one to look around.
gui.singulo.android_station.rules.hint: Switch to the page of route rules for patrols (required waypoints and no-entry zones)
gui.singulo.android_station.status.11: An android without a station is nearby
gui.singulo.android_station.status.2: Not enough power (%s FE needed to print)
gui.singulo.archivist.death_1: ...I have been dreaming a long dream.
gui.singulo.archivist.death_2: A record is only a record when someone reads it.
gui.singulo.archivist.death_3: Thank you. Please be someone who can stop when it is time to.
gui.singulo.archivist.emerge_2: Then let me show you the last page.
gui.singulo.archivist.halo: The halo unravels into spreading rings... Jump the low ones, crouch under the high ones!
gui.singulo.archivist.phase_2: Do you remember? Every record is here.
gui.singulo.archivist.phase_3: Light and records alike sink into this dark in the end.
gui.singulo.archivist.reset: No challenger remains. The Archivist returns to the time field, leaving the Terminus Record on the console
gui.singulo.archivist.shield_down: The field sealing the chamber unravels.
gui.singulo.archivist.shield_up: A field seals the chamber. No one leaves until it ends.
gui.singulo.archivist.tide: Let me read you the record of weight.
gui.singulo.archivist.tide_final: There is nowhere left to fall.
gui.singulo.archivist.wings: The Last Archivist spreads its six wings...
gui.singulo.archivist.wings_hint: Stand in the shadow of a wing!
gui.singulo.assembly.board_hint: Open the book on the right for the pattern. Each occupied cell supplies one part per craft. Put the catalyst in the amber slot.
gui.singulo.assembly.diagrams_hint: Hover over a product to see its diagram. Click it to keep the diagram on this button.
gui.singulo.assembly.upgrade_locked: Reduce every material cell to 64 items or fewer to remove the upgrade.
gui.singulo.brake.already: The flow in this section has already stopped
gui.singulo.brake.engaged: Brake pulled. The flow in this section stops
gui.singulo.cache.sealed: Sealed by a force field. Defeat this ruin's guardian
gui.singulo.catalyst.eject_hint: Click to take out the loaded catalyst
gui.singulo.catalyst.loaded_hint: When it runs out, the spent catalyst comes out and the next one loads from the reserve. Partly used catalysts you add are merged in.
gui.singulo.console.awakened: The seal breaks. The Horizon Warden awakens
gui.singulo.console.awakened_defeated: The awakened warden is defeated. Fine parts spill from the wreck
gui.singulo.console.awakened_rematch: The record core resonates. The Awakened Horizon Warden rises
gui.singulo.console.defeated: The warden falls silent. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.console.open: The vault is not sealed (use an Awakened Record Core to fight the awakened warden)
gui.singulo.console.reset: No challenger remains. The warden returns to its seal
gui.singulo.cosmic.phase.0: Gnocchi phase: nuclear matter in separate drops
gui.singulo.cosmic.phase.1: Spaghetti phase: drops have joined into rods
gui.singulo.cosmic.phase.2: Lasagna phase: rods have spread into sheets
gui.singulo.cosmic.slot.billet: Collapsar Billet, or a material to stretch (wool, iron ingot, blaze powder, leather or stone)
gui.singulo.device.forge.active: The core black hole is stable
